repository_sources_git_ref.name: repository_sources_git_ref
repository_sources_git_ref.value: "repository_sources"."git_ref" IS NULL OR length("repository_sources"."git_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

source_snapshots_object_ids.name: source_snapshots_object_ids
source_snapshots_object_ids.value: length("source_snapshots"."commit_sha") = 40 AND "source_snapshots"."commit_sha" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("source_snapshots"."tree_sha") = 40 AND "source_snapshots"."tree_sha" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

evaluations_complete_result.name: evaluations_complete_result
evaluations_complete_result.value: "evaluations"."state" <> 'complete' OR ("evaluations"."summary" IS NOT NULL AND length("evaluations"."result_digest") = 64)

evidence_index_lines.name: evidence_index_lines
evidence_index_lines.value: ("evidence_index"."location_kind" = 'lines') = ("evidence_index"."line_start" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_index"."line_end" IS NOT NULL)

applications_seal_id.name: applications_seal_id
applications_seal_id.value: "applications"."seal_id" IS NULL OR (length("applications"."seal_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "applications"."seal_id" = trim("applications"."seal_id"))

applications_name.name: applications_name
applications_name.value: "applications"."name" IS NULL OR length(trim("applications"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

de_console_links_linked_by.name: de_console_links_linked_by
de_console_links_linked_by.value: ("de_console_links"."basis" = 'resolved') = ("de_console_links"."linked_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("de_console_links"."linked_by" IS NULL OR length(trim("de_console_links"."linked_by")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

de_console_reads_outcome.name: de_console_reads_outcome
de_console_reads_outcome.value:
CASE "de_console_reads"."status"
        WHEN 'succeeded' THEN "de_console_reads"."applications" >= 0 AND "de_console_reads"."recorded" >= 0 AND "de_console_reads"."error" IS NULL
        WHEN 'failed' THEN "de_console_reads"."applications" IS NULL AND "de_console_reads"."recorded" IS NULL AND length("de_console_reads"."error") BETWEEN 1 AND 500
        ELSE 0 END

ownership_assertions_shape.name: ownership_assertions_shape
ownership_assertions_shape.value:
(CASE "ownership_assertions"."attribute"
        WHEN 'application' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" = 'set' AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_team" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'team' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" = 'set' AND length(trim("ownership_assertions"."value_team")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'line_of_business' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" = 'set' AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_team" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'portal' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" IN ('add', 'remove') AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_team" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'owner' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" = 'set' AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_team" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'host' THEN "ownership_assertions"."subject_portal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_repository_source_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."subject_application_id" IS NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."operation" = 'set' AND "ownership_assertions"."value_repository_source_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ownership_assertions"."value_application_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_team" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_line_of_business_id" IS NULL AND "ownership_assertions"."value_portal_id" IS NULL
        ELSE 0 END)

ownership_assertions_trust.name: ownership_assertions_trust
ownership_assertions_trust.value:
CASE "ownership_assertions"."source"
        WHEN 'de_console' THEN "ownership_assertions"."verification" = 'not_required' AND "ownership_assertions"."read_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "ownership_assertions"."verification" IN ('unverified', 'verified') AND "ownership_assertions"."read_at" IS NULL END

jobs_lease.name: jobs_lease
jobs_lease.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'running') = ("jobs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

demo_applications_bitbucket.name: demo_applications_bitbucket
demo_applications_bitbucket.value: ("demo_applications"."environment" = 'dev' AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_project" IS NOT NULL AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_repository" IS NOT NULL) OR ("demo_applications"."environment" = 'sandbox' AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_project" IS NULL AND "demo_applications"."bitbucket_repository" IS NULL)
